obligations.obligation: ED-B7CH11-001 (HIGH, combat.2_positions_and_movement_legible): make the supporting group's sixty meters and Cael's route/timing causally legible from the sixty-meter turn to the line crossing, preserving every required state.
obligations.evidence: Mechanism chosen: Cael draws the pack on a longer line (north off the lane to the road's rut, east along the rut the wrong way, then back west along the rut to the stone), holding the pack on himself until an audible signal from the stone tells him the unit is over; the second Wind burst is spent on the turn, not on the last forty. Repaired passages, in order: (1) the plan stated before he stops holding — "Brom was five strides behind Karis with the bow; Oryn had Lira; Seln would be back for Lira's other side. Sixty meters of grass in the dark, a woman carried and a girl on one foot, was a count he could not make shorter. So his would have to be longer." (2) the first burst's direction — "the loudest thing that had ever been inside this circle, on purpose — and not west. North, past the pack, off the lane, across the scrub toward the road's rut, away from five people who were about to move." (3) the route — "He ran through the middle of his own noise with the Iron read under his soles and the calf hot and the ribs stopping his breath at the tape, and came up out of the scrub onto the rut, and turned east along it, the wrong way. The dog that had cut the road was behind him now, with seven others, after the only declaration they had ever met on their floor." (4) the held interval, counted — "The count went backward. Eighty. A hundred. The lane lay a stone's throw south, where five people were going the other way in the dark, a woman carried and a boot coming down wrong, none of it louder than him. That was the whole of the job now. A hundred and twenty." (5) the signal that the unit is over, before he turns — "Then, from the stone, Seln said \"Back,\" in the voice he used for a distance, and Lira, from the ground, said it a breath after him, and Lira had been the slowest thing on the lane." (6) the second burst and its cost, honest — "One reached him in the second lock. / The second burst was the turn, west, back into the middle of eight animals that had followed him east, and the hound came inside the lock, low, at the leg, and he took it on the shoulder instead — Compression-adjacent, Reydan's, at contact ..." (7) the run home — "A hundred and twenty meters of rut, loud the whole way, so that nothing behind him looked south. Sixty. Forty. / Twenty meters." — followed by the unchanged tableau at twenty meters (Seln a stride beyond the stone, Brom beyond Seln with Karis over his shoulder, Oryn and Lira on the road's far edge) and "He crossed the line at a run." Drawable: two parallel east-west lines (the lane, the rut a stone's throw north) meeting at the stone; the unit's sixty meters west along the lane; Cael's roughly two hundred and seventy meters (north to the rut, east to about a hundred and twenty from the stone, west to the stone) with the pack behind him on the rut throughout. Preserved states: whole unit over before he crosses; Karis carried by Brom; Lira moved by Oryn (and Seln); Cael leads the pack out across the stone; Karis's ignition wall on the inside edge; two hounds dead (eye at the lip, chest at the stone), seven gone; all injuries as stated; Oryn's lines verbatim and untouched; burst count still two bursts, two locks, a dog in the second (log unchanged and still true).

obligations.obligation: ED-B7CH11-002 (LOW, production.anti_tic_and_banned_register_counts): keep the verbatim closing exchange but attach 'Yours.' to its preceding beat with attribution so the chapter has at most two one-word paragraphs.
obligations.evidence: Repaired passage: "It worked in there." / A beat, and then, still to the ring and not to him: "Yours." / "Yes," Cael said. / "Later." / "Later." — every word and the order kept; one-word paragraphs in the chapter now two ("Later." / "Later."), counted by awk over the file.

inventions: Cael's escape route: north off the cord-lane to the road's rut (the road the cut-dog had left when it went to Karis's sound), east along the rut away from the stone to about a hundred and twenty meters, then west along the rut to the stone — the pack on him the whole way, a stone's throw north of the lane the unit is walking west.

Seln's 'Back,' spoken from the stone in his distance voice while Cael is about a hundred and twenty meters out on the rut, with Lira's a breath after it, functions as the signal that the unit is over (Lira having been the slowest thing on the lane); Cael turns on it. The words are the draft's; only their timing and placement changed.

The second Wind burst is the turn back west through the pack that followed him east; the hound that reaches him does so inside that lock (previously staged at forty meters). Count unchanged: two bursts, two locks, one dog in the second.
state_change_proposals: Geometry of the retreat (replace the r1 note): from Karis's fall at sixty meters on the lane, the unit (Brom carrying Karis; Oryn with Lira; Seln on Lira's other side) went west along the cord-lane sixty meters to the stone while Cael drew the pack north to the road's rut, east along it to roughly a hundred and twenty meters from the stone, and back west along the rut to the stone. The pack followed the rut, not the lane. Cael's distance run inside the line after the fall is roughly two hundred and seventy meters, not sixty; the second Wind burst and lock (the dog on the shoulder, Compression at contact) occurred at the turn on the rut, about a hundred and twenty meters out, not at forty. Everything else (positions at close, both dead hounds' positions, the wall on the inside edge, the box at sixty recovered by Seln) unchanged.

Seln's 'Back' is now a distance call from the stone heard by Cael before his own crossing (his Shadow having returned at his stride, as before); Lira's 'Back' a breath after it, from the ground, is the last of the unit over. Cael crosses after both.
Seln's position after the fall: proposed (stated as Cael's expectation on the page) that Seln took Lira's other side on the lane — consistent with the r1 state note's 'Oryn and Seln'.
deviations: Word ceiling: the repair added roughly a hundred and thirty net words of choreography; to hold wc -w at or under 5,290 (final: 5,288), six small trims were made inside the repaired span only (r1 lines 117–153): the clause 'He had not used it on this side of the Line;' dropped from the Shadow paragraph (the seal logic that follows is intact); the one-line paragraph 'Seven heads in the scrub, and the one he had thrown, were turned to where the sound had been.' cut (its count is carried by 'Eight animals ... turned to it'); 'from the thing that did not happen' and 'in their lives' dropped; the Daeva-match clause in the run ('what he had not done since a matting floor against a Gold-tier woman') cut — the first-full-suite-since-Daeva fact remains twice on the page (the self-catalogue and the log); the 'struck pan' image on Storm and the 'every root and stone' clause on the Iron read shortened. No passage outside the finding's span was touched except the closing exchange (Finding 2).
'to nobody' was dropped from Seln's 'Back' because the line is now heard at a distance as a call; the words 'Back,' and 'in the voice he used for a distance' are kept. Oryn's lines are untouched.

Pack behaviour during the longer run relies only on what the r1 draft already established and the editor passed: the hounds come to the loudest declaration, a silent running body is nearly nothing to them, and they reach Cael only inside a landing lock. No new hound behaviour is added.
